description.en: Gives a character a Fighting Spirit, with the jingle J_07 and the message "sysmes-Avatar-00001" (RunAttachAvatarUseMsg). The spirit is attached with CMND_ATTACH_AVATAR and then locked unless _lock is false.
Parameter ID of the character, e.g. "para_cp0008".
true to lock the character's Fighting Spirit afterwards (CMND_SET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG(hdl, true)); otherwise the lock state it had before is kept.

examples.case: A character awakens a Fighting Spirit (real usage, from ev42111300.nut)
